title: Tropical Canopy ABC
hook: Sunlight threads the canopy layer by layer.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: bright 3D tropical canopy storybook, layered greens with sunbeams, one clear subject per frame, rounded preschool style

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child mapping rainforest height from ground layer to canopy and back down
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: restate vertical orientation and make height the memory device
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written vertical placement; do not falsely place ground animals high in trees, instead use contrast between layers
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: layer cue -> recall beat -> target -> point low/mid/high or object-specific gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make the canopy understandable as vertical space: floor, trunk, midstory and crown each hold different clues, and sunlight becomes the thread that pulls the alphabet upward.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child looks from low roots to high leaves; recurring language uses floor, trunk, climb, mid-level, overhead, gap, crown, shaft of light and down again.
semanticArc: reach bright canopy animals and leaves
look back down through the layered forest
forbiddenGenericLanguage: tropical words grow high with me
